import os
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Plot learning metrices
# Metrices 'Precision Value', 'Recall Value', 'F-score Value'
def plot_metrics(df,metrics,title, filename):
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

    # Corresponding colors for each metric
    colors = ['blue', 'green', 'red', 'purple', 'orange',]

    for metric, color in zip(metrics, colors):
        plt.plot(df['Epoch'], df[metric], label=metric, color=color)

    plt.xlabel('Epoch')
    plt.ylabel('Performance')
    plt.title(title)
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(True)

    # Save figure
    plt.savefig(filename)

    plt.show()
